Package io.micronaut.el

@NullMarked package io.micronaut.el
A Jakarta Expression Language implementation whose expressions and resolvers are generated at compilation time.
Since:
1.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    Description
    CompiledELContext
    A standalone ELContext backed by the resolvers generated at compilation time.
    CompiledExpressionFactory
    The ExpressionFactory returning the expressions compiled at compilation time.
    ContributedELMethodExecutor
    Dispatches the methods every ELMethodContributor on the classpath registered.
    ELBeanProvider
    Provides the instances the functions declared on beans are invoked on.
    ELContributions
    What the ELMethodContributor services of the classpath registered, merged into one registry.
    ELExecutors
    The ELMethodExecutor services of the classpath, which describe a method without reflecting.
    ELExpressionParser
    Creates the expressions that were not compiled at compilation time.
    ELExpressionSource
    A source of the expressions compiled at compilation time.
    ELMethod
    A method resolved by an ELMethodExecutor.
    ELMethodContributor
    Contributes the methods, constructors and functions that expressions parsed at runtime may call, without reflection.
    ELMethodExecutor
    Resolves and executes methods for expressions parsed at runtime.
    ELMethodRegistry
    Declares the methods, constructors and functions an ELMethodContributor makes callable from expressions parsed at runtime, and turns them into an ELMethodExecutor that dispatches them directly, without reflection.
    ELMethodRegistry.Call0<T,R>
    Invokes an instance method taking no argument.
    ELMethodRegistry.Call1<T,A,R>
    Invokes an instance method taking one argument.
    ELMethodRegistry.Call2<T,A,B,R>
    Invokes an instance method taking two arguments.
    ELMethodRegistry.Fn0<R>
    Invokes a static method, a constructor or a function taking no argument.
    ELMethodRegistry.Fn1<A,R>
    Invokes a static method, a constructor or a function taking one argument.
    ELMethodRegistry.Fn2<A,B,R>
    Invokes a static method, a constructor or a function taking two arguments.
    ELMethodRegistry.Invocation
    Invokes a registered method of any arity.
    ELMethodRegistry.Lambda<T>
    Builds an instance of a functional interface that runs a lambda expression.
    ELProxyFactory
    Implements a functional interface nothing described in advance, which is the last resort of the coercion of the section 1.23.2 of the specification.
    ELSandbox
    The types and members an expression parsed at runtime may reach.
    ELSandbox.StandardELSandbox
    The default deny list.
    ELSandboxException
    Raised when an expression parsed at runtime reaches a type or a member its ELSandbox denies.
